name: d2c_mpnn13_S88D_serasp
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE -- not shown to bind. The project's causal result on a second, unrelated backbone: parent wild-type 0.70x (no switch) -> single Ser88->Asp 4.57x on the superseded target-only basis (3.53x his-only, the graded basis) -> truncating that Asp back to Ala in the same coordinates 0.72x. Knockout effect +5.20 pKa units, the largest measured here. pH = median over 5 refold poses; target's native H433. Predicted affinity 0.603 human / 0.528 mouse.

name: bc_d3acid_l65_s831683_mpnn11
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE -- not shown to bind. Unmutated ProteinMPNN sequence on the d3acid_l65_s831683 backbone -- the same backbone as the four S15D designs and the matched wild-type -- Position 15 is SER in this sequence, not Asp -- this row previously read "carrying a native Asp at the equivalent position", which is wrong: its aspartates are at 24, 30, 38 and 55, and position 15 is the unmutated serine. It is an unmutated MPNN sequence on the shared backbone, which is what makes it useful, but it carries no S15D-equivalent substitution. pH 0.74x his-only (the graded basis) and 4.01x on the superseded target-only basis, median over 6 refold poses; target's native H433. Predicted affinity 0.796 human / 0.784 mouse -- among the highest in the pool. No cysteine. Seven of the eighteen submitted rows share this backbone: that is a deliberate trade of panel diversity for wet-lab replication of the only causal result we have.

name: rimA02_d3_rimA_14_vhh
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE. VHH format: antibody-rule Level 3 (CDRH3 13.6%, global 84.8%, source analysis/01-egfr/novelty_ANTIBODY.tsv). pH 4.84x his-only (graded basis), median over 6 refold poses; 5.19x on the superseded target-only basis, switching on the target's native H433. AFFINITY INADEQUATELY ASSESSED, NOT LOW: this instrument scores a real 5 nM VHH at 0.0000 with 5/5 dead seeds, and scores four framework-preserving CDR decoys on that same VHH scaffold at 0.0000 too -- it cannot separate a validated nanobody from a randomised-CDR decoy. The 0.228/0.451 columns are reported for completeness and should not be read as weak binding. EXPRESSION LIABILITY, measured 2026-10-05: pI 6.38 (6.41 Bjellqvist, 6.54 EMBOSS), so this design sits within 0.12 units of its ISOELECTRIC POINT in the pH 6.5 assay buffer, where its net charge is -0.0. A protein at its pI is at minimum solubility, and that is the condition under which the headline low-pH measurement is taken. Every other submitted design sits at pI 3.57-4.72 and carries -5 to -15 net charge at pH 6.5. Also 2 Cys, the canonical VHH framework pair.

name: bc_s831683_mpnn8_S15D
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE -- not shown to bind. Single Ser->Asp installed at position 15 on the best-binding BindCraft backbone (d3acid_l65_s831683). Matched wild-type, same batch, same gate: 3.15x -> 5.46x. Predicted affinity 0.821->0.776 human / 0.807->0.764 mouse, i.e. the switch is installed at a small affinity cost, not free. Switching residue is the TARGET's own H433 (native domain III, conserved in mouse) -- not an affinity tag. pH = median over 5 ESMFold2 refold poses. 5.46x is a TARGET-ONLY (superseded) reading -- this design's graded his-only column is 1.023x -- and on that superseded basis it is 98% of H433's single-site thermodynamic ceiling (5.55x), so the four S15D designs span 0.22 pKa units and are NOT distinguishable from one another.

name: bc_s831683_mpnn9_WT
assessment: MATCHED WILD-TYPE CONTROL, submitted on purpose and not as a candidate. Identical to `bc_s831683_mpnn9_S15D` except position 15 (Ser vs Asp). It reads 3.52x as the median over 26 refold poses against that design's 5.43x (both on the superseded target-only basis; on the GRADED his-only basis 0.627x against 1.062x, and on the all-site basis 1.195x against 1.804x. This read "on the all-site basis 0.593x against 1.057x": those two figures are pre-pose-expansion HIS-ONLY values, not all-site ones). If `bc_s831683_mpnn9_S15D` switches and this does not, the Ser->Asp mechanism is established in the laboratory independently of every threshold in our methods document; if both switch equally, the mutation is not the cause and that is equally informative. Predicted affinity 0.783 human / 0.783 mouse.

name: h370_020_vhh
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE. VHH format: antibody-rule Level 4 (CDRH3 27.3%, global 52.6%) -- the only de novo design in this set under that rule. Note it is Level 2 under the general-protein rule (TM 0.914), so its eligibility depends on being classified as an antibody. CDR3 AAVDDETGDIY is carboxylate-rich and pairs with the target's native H433. pH 2.10x his-only (graded basis), 2.29x on the superseded target-only basis, pooled over 11 refold poses in two independent arms. AFFINITY INADEQUATELY ASSESSED -- VHH format, see `rimA02_d3_rimA_14_vhh`.

name: bc_s360518_mpnn9_A22D
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE -- not shown to bind. Single Ala->Asp at position 22 on a backbone not otherwise represented in this submission (d3acid3_l65_s360518). Matched wild-type, same gate, same pose count: 0.826x -> 5.630x, a 6.82x causal swing -- the largest in the submission, and larger than any of the four S15D pairs. Tightest seed reproducibility in the project ON THE SUPERSEDED TARGET-ONLY BASIS: 5.616 / 5.626 / 5.630 / 5.631 / 5.662 over 5 poses (median 5.630, this row's ph_ratio_target_only_SUPERSEDED column). The graded his-only value is 3.738x and the superlative has not been re-established on it, no dead seeds on either species. The install costs affinity: -0.165 human, -0.119 mouse against its wild-type. Switching residue is the TARGET's native H433. Novelty re-measured on the MUTANT pose, not the wild-type backbone: TM 0.792, identity 15.2%, Level 3 -- it clears, but by 0.008, and the organisers' rule is domain-wise where splitting can only raise TM, so this is the row most exposed to a novelty rejection at upload. Expression QC clean: 0 Cys, GRAVY -1.225, longest hydrophobic run 2, no deamidation motif. On the GRADED histidine-only basis it reads 3.738x against a wild-type 0.574x -- swing 6.51x. This previously called 3.738x "the all-titratable-site basis": it is not. 3.738 is this row's ph_ratio_6p5_over_7p4_his_only_CONSERVATIVE column and its ph_ratio_allsite_SENSITIVITY column reads 88.593, so the sentence presented the headline number a second time as if it were an independent multi-site check.

name: rimA01_r15_L133E
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE, AND THE LEAST REPRODUCIBLE ROW IN THIS SUBMISSION -- ranked last in tier 1 for that reason, not for its ratio. Single Leu->Glu at position 133 of `rimA01_r15_boltzgen_egfr_d3_rimA_20`, which is submitted unmodified as its matched parent. It is the only design here with evidence of TWO coupled sites: his-only median 5.659x on five poses (5.656x on twenty; this row's all-site column reads 52.181x, so calling 5.659 the all-site value mislabelled the basis), above the 5.55x thermodynamic ceiling for H433 alone, with H433 at 3.504-4.819x across all 20 poses (this read "4.458-4.675x across all five poses", a five-pose figure) while H370 -- which reads 0.92-0.94x in every other design in this submission -- pulls 0.921 to 2.584x. Two of five poses exceed the 7.94x one-proton bound, which is multi-site by arithmetic. Affinity FLAT, not improved: at n = 20 the human leg is 0.598 against the parent's 0.594 (the earlier 0.616 was five-pose noise and is withdrawn, METHODS 11.6), mouse 0.567 -> 0.435. WHY IT IS RANKED LAST: the pose spread at n = 20 is 3.838-28.629, i.e. 4.38x the median (the earlier 1.31x was a five-pose figure and is withdrawn, METHODS 11.6), against 0.040-1.760 for every other row -- two of which, bc_s831683_mpnn9_S15D (1.21) and bc_s831683_mpnn9_WT (1.76), also exceed 0.90, so this row is the least reproducible but not uniquely so (this read "0.04-0.90 for every other row"). By our own standard (METHODS 6) a median over poses that scattered is not a measurement, and the effect over its parent (1.33x) sits inside that scatter. What varies pose to pose is whether the glutamate reaches H370 at all. The Glu/Asp distinction is the mechanism and it is testable: L133D at the same position reads 2.221x at n = 15 (the earlier 0.723x came from too few poses and is withdrawn, METHODS 11.6) with human affinity 0.000 -- Asp spans ~2.5A from CB and LEU133 sits 6.28A from H370, so Asp buries a charge with no partner and destroys the interface, while Glu (~3.9A) reaches. Novelty on the mutant pose: TM 0.702, identity 19.2%, Level 3, margin 0.098. QC: 0 Cys, GRAVY +0.188 (the most hydrophobic row here), longest hydrophobic run 5. Submitted because a two-sided mechanism with its negative control measured is worth testing even at n=1; it needs 10-15 seeds and an isosteric L133Q control to be a result.

name: c5_cf_short__boltzgen_egfr_cropfree_short_48
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE -- not shown to bind. 70 aa. ADDED 2026-10-05 from the reopened exclusion pool (METHODS 10): it was excluded on the pH gate alone, which is not a validated selection rule, and on re-scoring with the SAME two-partner histidine-only gate as the original finalists it reads 5.546x over 6 human-leg poses (pose spread 0.262 of the median). Predicted affinity 0.241 human / 0.181 mouse (pooled medians). Novelty Level 3 (FoldSeek vs PDB, same gate as the finalists). EXPRESSION LIABILITY, measured 2026-10-05: this is the one design of the eighteen that bin/express_qc.py flags for HYDROPHOBIC-RUN. It is 30.0% alanine (21 of 70), carries a 7-residue poly-alanine run and an 8-residue hydrophobic run, and has GRAVY +0.46 -- the highest in the submission, where every other design sits at +0.24 or below. Binders are made by E. coli cell-free synthesis, which is the regime where long hydrophobic runs aggregate. Read this row's pH ratio alongside a real risk that the molecule does not express well. All pH tiers in this submission are PROVISIONAL: Kendall tau between this ranking basis and the partnered alternative is +0.000 (METHODS 11.7).

name: bcr_d3acid3_l60_s647537_mpnn11
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE -- not shown to bind. 60 aa. ADDED 2026-10-05 from the reopened exclusion pool (METHODS 10), REPLACING a near-duplicate addition. On the same two-partner histidine-only gate as every other row it reads 2.747x over 6 human-leg poses, pose spread 0.057 of the median -- among the tightest in the submission. Predicted affinity 0.443 human / 0.234 mouse (pooled medians). Novelty Level 3 on the same FoldSeek gate as the originals. Highest sequence identity to any other submitted design: 0.867, to bcr_d3acid3_l60_s647537_mpnn3, which is also submitted -- the two differ at 8 of 60 positions and are MPNN redesigns of one backbone, not independent designs. Identity to everything else submitted is <0.47. Its three pH bases agree to within 7.8% (his-only 2.747 / all-site 2.918 / partnered 2.960) -- fourth-tightest of any submitted design. This previously read "within 8% ... the closest agreement of any submitted design", a superlative that this row and bcr_d3acid3_l60_s647537_mpnn3 both claimed; neither holds it. Expression QC NOT RUN. All pH tiers are PROVISIONAL: METHODS 11.7 shows that under PROPKA's own +/-0.8 pKa accuracy the pH ratio cannot order this submission, so read this as a member of a top set, not as a rank.

name: ss_bc_s831683_mpnn6_S15D_S62H_routeA
assessment: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE -- not shown to bind. 65 aa. RESTORED 2026-10-05 as a DELIBERATE PARENT/MUTANT PAIR with bc_s831683_mpnn6_S15D, which ships alongside it. It is that design plus Ser62His and is 0.985 identical to it. It was added earlier the same day on pH ranking alone, removed as a 'nearly identical variant', and is restored on a different and stated basis: the pair exists so the S62H effect is MEASURED in the laboratory rather than inferred from our gate, which is the same reason the rimA01_r15/L133E and mpnn9_S15D/mpnn9_WT pairs ship. The review asked for both -- 'keep the experimental WT/mutant comparisons AND avoid filling available slots with nearly identical variants' -- and a declared parent/mutant pair is the first, not the second. Why this mutation: S62H is the only REPLICATED result of the 12-design second-site arm (METHODS 10c), raising its parent 1.93x here and 1.80x at the same position on the sister sequence mpnn19_S15D, against an arm median of 0.98x. pH 3.545x over 5 poses, spread 0.358. Predicted affinity 0.765 human / 0.744 mouse, indistinguishable from its parent's 0.780/0.751. Independent Chai-1 check: ipTM 0.838 with a 39-residue interface, the joint-largest in the validation set and above both working positives (cetuximab scFv 0.793, human EGF 0.500) -- the best-corroborated design in this submission. Novelty Level 3. Expression QC NOT RUN. All pH tiers PROVISIONAL per METHODS 11.7.
